name: 62347 · Liberty, IL
findings: ZIP 62347 (Liberty) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62347 (Liberty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62347 (Liberty) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
